column1: # C100 final campaign slot table (the ONE place that defines slots; camp-fin.sh and run-fin.sh read it). Tab-separated:
# slot tier proto raised spr nb rpb30 cfgs rows
# C100 fin rename (supervisor 2026-11-05): StringJoiner = former jdk-micro, StringSubstring = former jdk-micro-c99 (StringSubstring
#   benchmarks only); template-benchmark nb 3 (orchestrator 2026-11-05; was 5).
#   tier A = the 18 FULL wins (FULL+BASE), B = the 19 per-rep rows (BASE SBS SV LS), C = the 18 neutral rows + the 21 C98 hunt rows (C100 fin tier C, SD 2026-11-05; slots CL4-CL7 CP1 CN1) (FULL+BASE)
#   proto uniform (UW=3 UM=5 US=2) | legacy (port/server/owasp/lucene rows keep their own measurement) | jmh (C100 fin jmh,
#     supervisor 2026-11-05: JMH rows only, every one with -f 0 -wi 5 -w 1s -i 10 -r 1s; 1 start per build and config =
#     RPB 1, i.e. 3 builds x 1 start x 10 measured iterations = 30 measured iterations per sub-benchmark; NOT under the
#     30-start rule; camp-fin runs it as legacy)
#   raised y = MEASX=MEAS3=$RAISED (default 1): only lucene-bytask (3 rounds per start) is left; JMH rows ignore RAISED
#   spr = timed process starts per run and arm (uniform US=2; recipe NSTART otherwise); nb = builds per config
#   rpb30 = runs per build for 30 starts per config (nb x rpb30 x spr = 30; jmh: 1); run-fin.sh derives RPB from the tier
#     target (jmh slots: always 1)
#   C100 fin tier C2 (SD 2026-11-05): CL8 CP2 CP3 CX1 = 5 hunt rows added with documented exceptions (c100_final_tierC2.md);
#     CX1 has a FIXED RPB 2 (run-fin.sh/est.py FIXED_RPB: 3 builds x 2 starts, each start = 5 measured loops per row)
#   C100 fin extra (orchestrator/supervisor 2026-11-10; docs/archive/research/c100_final_extra_slots.md): tier X = extra
#     measurement slots after the campaign (own tier tag: the frozen tier A/B/C targets and fu-<t>.done markers stay untouched;
#     X_STARTS default 15; the protocol comes from proto, as everywhere). Optional columns 10-11 (rows without them: unchanged):
#     cpus  = per-slot CPU override for every row of the slot, replacing cpus.tsv's CPUS ("-" = cpus.tsv). Documented exception
#             (supervisor 2026-11-10): XU1 "sunflow pinned to 2 cores: with 16 threads each process settles into a fast or
#             slow mode independent of build/config" -> 4,6 = 2 physical cores without SMT siblings (the pre-C100 setting);
#             CPUS is not in the image stamp; the JVM sanity reference re-keys on it (refkey cpus=)
#     reuse = the slot's build-phase REUSE_FROM ("-" = FIN_REUSE default; "none" = empty = every image a new build; else
#             kit-relative or absolute OUT dirs): XU1 reuses the CU2 sunflow images (bld/CU2), XL1 = jte FULL re-run with
#             new BASE and FULL builds (a new layout draw; same recipe/flags as AL1, tier-A JMH protocol)
#   C100 fin a128 (supervisor 2026-11-10; docs/archive/research/c100_a128_slot.md): optional column 12 align = per-slot
#     -H:CodeAlignment override of BOTH sides ("-" = the campaign 64). Documented: "footnote control: CodeAlignment=128 on
#     both sides, not a table value". The value is in every image stamp (flags= + an xalign=<n> token), so nothing is reused
#     across alignments; XL2 = snakeyaml + jsqlparser BASE FULL at 128, 3 new builds per config (reuse none), tier-A/C JMH protocol,
#     CPUs from cpus.tsv (0-15); profile gate vs the 64-alignment CL4/CL5 builds (profchk.sh, tier-X SELFREF rows)
#   C100 fin a128 sunflow (orchestrator 2026-11-10; c100_a128_slot.md section 10): XU2 = dacapo-sunflow BASE FULL at CodeAlignment=128
#     on both sides, CPUs 4,6 (as XU1), 3 new builds per config (reuse none), uniform protocol as XU1/CU2 (18 starts per config);
#     profile gate vs the 64-alignment CU2 builds (profchk.sh: tier-X align-override rows get the campaign-slot check too)
#   C100 fin newwins (supervisor 2026-11-10; docs/archive/research/c100_newwins_slots.md, pi brief pi-brief-newwins.txt): owasp,
#     commons-csv and antlr count as NEW WINS (out of the neutral tier: CO, CL1, CN1) and get the win-tier treatment as tier-X slots
#     (SKIP_FU; fu-X.done exists, so no tier-X report re-run):
#     XA1 = antlr BASE FULL at the tier-A run count: CN1 had 3 builds x RPB 2 x NSTART 4 = 24 starts per config (< 30); re-measured
#           FULLY (one consistent measurement, no pooling with CN1) on the CN1 images (reuse bld/CN1, fresh copies, no builds) with
#           FIXED_RPB XA1:3 = 36 starts per config (= the README tier-A/C realisation for NSTART-4 metric rows). owasp (CO: 3 x 2 x 5
#           = 30 starts per config) and commons-csv (CL1: 3 builds x 1 start x 10 = 30 measured iterations) already meet tier A.
#     XB1 owasp / XB2 antlr / XB3 commons-csv = BASE SBS SV LS at the tier-B protocol (one slot per row: different spr/proto = one
#           RPB per slot): XB1 FIXED_RPB 1 = 3 x 1 x 5 = 15 starts per config (the default "at least 2" would give 30); XB2 RPB 2 =
#           3 x 2 x 4 = 24 (the smallest whole-run count >= 15); XB3 jmh 3 builds x 1 start. BASE = the rows' campaign images
#           (reuse bld/CO, bld/CN1, bld/CL1: stamp match, BASE:RRR), SBS/SV/LS = 9 new builds per slot. Profile gate: the per-rep
#           configs of these rows have no reference (no C99/asf profile, no campaign-slot build): within-slot agreement b1=b2=b3
#           (profchk.sh NOREF list, as the tier-C hunt rows); CPUs from cpus.tsv (0-15, = CO/CN1/CL1)
#   C100 fin neutral5 (orchestrator 2026-11-10; docs/archive/research/c100_neutral5_prep.md, pi brief pi-brief-neutral5.txt): step 2 of the
